shell-math-intro: Use the shells to work out the number.
shell-math-help: Look at the equation. Tap Join one shell for adding, or Take away one shell for subtraction. Count the shells left on the sand, then choose an answer. Show me fills in the picture and equation so you can try together. You can always try again. Tap Next when you are ready.
number-hop-intro: Hop along the number line to work out the answer.
number-hop-help: Start at the marked number. Adding hops forward. Taking away hops back. Each tap makes one hop. When the hops are done, choose the number where you landed. Slide the line to see more numbers. Show me can help you.
quick-practice-intro: Try a little number question. You can ask for help.
quick-practice-help: Look at the equation and choose the number that fills the gap. Sometimes the missing number is in the middle. Show me gives you a picture and a completed equation. You can try again without losing your place.
practice-intro: Three little questions, then your game. You can ask for help.
practice-show: Look at the picture. You can count with me.
practice-read: Read the word. Tap the matching picture.
